events.description: 6. ORDERED as follows: 1) The Plaintiffs' emergency motion for temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, and declaratory relief (doc. 2 ) is DENIED to the extent they seek a temporary restraining order without first affording Governor Ivey an opportunity to be heard; 2) The Plaintiffs' emergency motion for temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, and declaratory relief (doc. 2 ) is GRANTED to the extent that the motion is SET for an evidentiary hearing and oral argument on May 15, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. CT in Courtroom 2A, Frank M. Johnson Jr. United States Courthouse, One Church Street, Montgomery, Alabama. The Clerk of the Court is DIRECTED to provide a court reporter; 3) As soon as practicable but no later than 5:00 p.m. CT on May 8, 2025, the Plaintiffs shall file a supplemental brief clarifying on which Count or Counts of their complaint they seek a temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, or both; 4) As soon as practicable but no later than 5:00 p.m. CT on May 12, 2025, Governor Ivey shall file a response to the Plaintiffs' motion and supplemental brief; 5) The Plaintiffs shall file a reply brief no later than 12:00 p.m. CT on May 14, 2025; 6) Contemporaneous with filing, the parties shall provide courtesy copies of their written submissions to the Court, in Word and PDF format, via email to markschambers@almd.uscourts.gov; 7) The Clerk of the Court is DIRECTED to send a copy of this Order to Attorney Jim Davis of the Alabama Attorney General's Office via email at Jim.Davis@AlabamaAG.gov. Signed by Chief Judge Emily C. Marks on 5/6/2025. (CWL) (Entered: 05/06/2025)
